depth.correction: The result counts unique value triples, not index combinations. Sorting [-1,0,1,2,-1,-4] gives [-4,-1,-1,0,1,2]. The unique triples are [-1,-1,2] and [-1,0,1], so the count is 2. Multiple zero indexes still produce one [0,0,0] value triple.
